coverage.note: A prior needs 5 prior years within +/-15 days of the race date. Every race in the corpus clears that because the archive starts in 1995.

separation.note: FR-206's two roles come from one endpoint separated only by date range. The prior reads years strictly before the race's own; the cut-off is derived from the race date, so no caller can widen it.

sanity.note: A climatological prior should correlate positively but weakly with what actually happened. A strong correlation would mean it was reading the race.

provenance.licence: Open-Meteo: free for non-commercial use; ERA5 via Copernicus (CC-BY-4.0)
provenance.role_split: Days before the race year form the FR-206 climatological prior (PRE_RACE). The race day itself is POST_RACE and reachable only from the oracle set.

corpus_provenance.stamped_retroactively: stamped after the fact, on 2026-09-05, from the seasons this file already names. It was written before results files carried provenance; re-running it would refetch an unchanged corpus over the network.
